description: ADR-0020: least-privilege capability for the Tauri + Python Sidecar migration. Every permission is explicit (Tauri v2 ships zero permissions by default). The shell:allow-spawn permission is scoped to ONLY the python-sidecar binary via the plugins.shell.scope in tauri.conf.json — Tauri v2 enforces both the capability permission AND the config scope at runtime. Tray: the Python sidecar owns the tray via pystray (no Tauri-mode branch needed; the sidecar inherits the desktop session from externalBin spawn), so no core:tray:* permissions are granted to the Rust host. FT-1 full-app relaunch uses AppHandle::restart() (core tauri crate, no plugin required), so no process:allow-restart capability is needed.
